source_refs.note: Topic 19.4 (PDF 130); the photograph of Francis Crick is replaced by an original drawing.

blocks.text: You know that a gene is a specific sequence of nucleotides along the DNA strand which directs the synthesis of a polypeptide (protein). In other words, a gene expresses itself by making a protein or an enzyme that controls the development of a specific trait.

blocks.alt: Drawing of Francis Crick, an elderly man with untidy white hair and a slight smile, in a dark suit, white shirt and light patterned tie, seen from the waist up against a dark sky with a tall stepped building at the left.
blocks.caption: Francis Crick (original drawing after the photograph printed in the textbook).

blocks.text: All organisms use the same basic mechanism of expressing genes.
